dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: I wonder who will have the honor of offering the Windblume to Lord Barbatos this year?

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm so envious. If only I could be the one.

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: (If I had to pick a flower to give away, which one should I choose? Agh, what a dilemma...)

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: (Let me think of this a different way. If... If I want to find the flower that fits Master Diluc the most...)

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: (Gosh... Now all I can think about is Diluc...)
